name: Grooming Kit / Trimmer Set
issues: Specific model number (such as PG series) is not visible on this side panel of the packaging.
verification_notes: Specific model number is not visible on this packaging side panel.

Multiple Remington grooming kits (including PG180, PG6030, PG6060, and PG6130) feature the identical set of attachment heads ('Wide Trimmer', 'Detail Trimmer', 'Nose & Ear Trimmer', 'Mini Foil Shaver'), making unique model confirmation impossible without the model code or front panel.
